about.heroTitle: Empowering India’s Pulse Value Chain with Predictive Market Clarity
about.heroDesc: AgriPulse AI is an enterprise-grade agricultural decision support system engineered to forecast wholesale price volatility for pulses across India’s primary Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs). By connecting real-time mandi dispatches, localized precipitation patterns, and historical price memory, AgriPulse AI delivers 14-day forward volatility visibility to procurement teams, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), millers, and agricultural risk managers.
about.scopeTurDesc: Tur Dal (also known as Arhar or Pigeon Pea) is one of India’s most critical dietary protein staples. It is primarily cultivated in Maharashtra, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, and Gujarat as a rainfed Kharif crop with a 5-to-6 month maturation cycle.
about.scopeApmcDesc: Located in Vashi, Navi Mumbai, the Mumbai APMC Grain Market serves as Western India’s premier pulse consumption and transit exchange, receiving daily dispatches from Vidarbha, Marathwada, and import terminals at JNPT.
about.scalableSub: The platform is built on configuration-driven schemas ready to onboard additional pulses and trading centers without code refactoring
